data_description.price_entity: Optional sensor providing the current electricity price.
data_description.pricing_strategy: Required when a price sensor is selected. Choose how that sensor's price is produced.
data_description.price_included_components: Required when a price sensor is selected. Select every variable component already contained in the sensor value; Market energy must be included.
data_description.price_vat_treatment: Required when a price sensor is selected. State whether its value includes VAT.
data_description.price_vat_rate: Rate added only to VAT-exclusive live prices and Nord Pool forecasts. Already VAT-inclusive prices and configured VAT-inclusive fees are not taxed again. An unset rate is prefilled from a known Swedish, Danish or Finnish area. Check or edit before saving. Norway requires household-location confirmation and Iceland depends on supply type; use the suggestion helper if unsure. 0 means actual zero VAT, not that the source excludes VAT.
data_description.suggest_vat_rate: Optional: review a VAT suggestion or choose a country if no Nord Pool area is known. A known country is used directly. Existing rates, including 0%, stay unchanged unless you replace them.
data_description.supplier_markup_per_kwh: Optional: Supplier markup in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor, including VAT. It is not added twice when the live price already includes markup, and it can still enrich a market-only forecast.
data_description.fixed_supplier_fee_monthly: Optional: Monthly fixed cost from the electricity supplier, if any.
data_description.accumulated_cost_today_entity: Optional external supplier-cost sensor reporting cost accumulated since midnight. Leave empty to estimate costs from the configured energy and price sources. Estimates have partial coverage. Do not select a fixed monthly fee.

data_description.power_entity: Required sensor providing the current power.

data_description.pricing_strategy: Required when a price sensor is selected. Choose how that sensor's price is produced.
data_description.price_included_components: Required when a price sensor is selected. Select every variable component already contained in the sensor value; Market energy must be included.
data_description.price_vat_treatment: Required when a price sensor is selected. State whether its value includes VAT.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional sensor providing either today's consumption or a total accumulated energy reading.
data_description.energy_source_type: Choose whether the selected energy sensor resets each day or reports total accumulated imported energy. Electricity Pro derives today's consumption from a total accumulated reading.
data_description.accumulated_cost_today_entity: Optional external supplier-cost sensor reporting cost accumulated since midnight. Leave empty to estimate costs from the configured energy and price sources. Estimates have partial coverage. Do not select a fixed monthly fee.
data_description.current_l1_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L1.
data_description.current_l2_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L2.
data_description.current_l3_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L3.
data_description.voltage_l1_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L1.
data_description.voltage_l2_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L2.
data_description.voltage_l3_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L3.
data_description.monthly_peak_hour_consumption_entity: Optional sensor providing monthly peak hour consumption.
data_description.monthly_peak_hour_time_entity: Optional timestamp sensor providing when the monthly peak hour occurred.
data_description.grid_fee_per_kwh: Optional: Grid fee in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor, including VAT. In Sweden, this is typically 0.10–0.35 SEK/kWh, depending on the grid provider.
data_description.price_vat_rate: Rate added only to VAT-exclusive live prices and Nord Pool forecasts. Already VAT-inclusive prices and configured VAT-inclusive fees are not taxed again. An unset rate is prefilled from a known Swedish, Danish or Finnish area. Check or edit before saving. Norway requires household-location confirmation and Iceland depends on supply type; use the suggestion helper if unsure. 0 means actual zero VAT, not that the source excludes VAT.
data_description.supplier_markup_per_kwh: Optional: Supplier markup in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor, including VAT. It is not added twice when the live price already includes markup, and it can still enrich a market-only forecast.
data_description.energy_tax_per_kwh: Optional: Energy tax per kWh in the local currency, including VAT. For example, 0.45 SEK/kWh in Sweden. Check your grid agreement or bill because rates can change and reduced regional rates may apply.
data_description.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: Optional: Add a high-period fee to enable a weekday high/low tariff. The ordinary grid fee above is then used as the low-period fee.
data_description.grid_fee_high_start: Local start time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 06:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_end: Local end time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 22:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_start: First date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 11-01.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_end: Last date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 03-31.
data_description.grid_fee_workday_entity: Optional: First add Home Assistant's Workday integration and configure your country (for example Sweden) with Holidays excluded. Then select its Workday sensor here. Dates reported as non-working use the low grid fee.
data_description.fixed_supplier_fee_monthly: Optional: Monthly fixed cost from the electricity supplier, if any.
data_description.fixed_grid_fee_monthly: Optional: Monthly fixed cost from the grid provider.
data_description.good_price_threshold: In Fixed mode, this is the maximum Effective Price considered good. In Adaptive mode, it is the optional fallback while history is warming up.
data_description.good_price_mode: Fixed preserves the existing threshold rule. Adaptive compares the current complete Effective Price with comparable historical local hours.
data_description.adaptive_target_percentile: Adaptive mode considers prices within this cheapest share of comparable historical observations favourable. The default is 25%.
data_description.adaptive_price_ceiling: Optional: Even when relatively favourable, a price above this absolute Effective Price is never classified as good.
data_description.forecast_nordpool_config_entry: Optional native Nord Pool integration used for forecast retrieval. Its configured area and currency are inherited automatically.
data_description.suggest_vat_rate: Optional: review a VAT suggestion or choose a country if no Nord Pool area is known. A known country is used directly. Existing rates, including 0%, stay unchanged unless you replace them.

data.vat_context: Household location or electricity supply type

vat_review.title: Review household VAT suggestion
vat_review.description: Context: {context}. Previously entered rate: {previous}. Sources last checked: {verified}. [Tax authority guidance]({source}). Check the rate against your bill and edit it if necessary. Confirm only if this context applies to the household supply. It applies to VAT-exclusive live prices and Nord Pool forecasts; Tibber's VAT-inclusive live price and gross fees remain unchanged. This is a one-time saved rate, not automatic future tax updates. Leave confirmation off to keep the previous setting.

data.use_vat_suggestion: Confirm this rate for my household

grid.title: Grid charges
grid.description: Choose which grid charges you want to configure. Changing the tariff type displays its fields before saving. Use amounts from your grid agreement or bill, including VAT, in the same currency as your prices. Blank means unknown; enter 0 only for an actual zero charge. Components declared as already included under Electricity supplier are not added twice to live prices. These amounts can still apply to Nord Pool forecasts.

data.grid_fee_per_kwh: Variable grid fee per kWh (including VAT)
data.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: High-period grid fee per kWh (including VAT)

data_description.grid_mode: Unconfigured clears the grid amounts and schedule; it does not assume grid charges are zero. Single rate allows a variable fee, energy tax and/or monthly fixed fee. High/low requires both rates and a schedule.
data_description.grid_fee_per_kwh: Optional for a single rate; required as the low-period fee for a high/low tariff.
data_description.energy_tax_per_kwh: Optional. Use the applicable rate from your bill, including regional reductions. No national rate is assumed.
data_description.fixed_grid_fee_monthly: Optional fixed fee from the grid provider. Keep capacity charges and electricity-supplier fees separate.
data_description.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: The full high-period rate, not an addition to the low rate. Zero is a valid rate.
data_description.grid_fee_high_start: Local start time on Monday–Friday, for example 06:00. Overnight periods are supported.
data_description.grid_fee_high_end: Local end time on Monday–Friday, for example 22:00. Must differ from the start.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_start: First date of the recurring season, for example 11-01.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_end: Last date of the recurring season, for example 03-31. A season can span New Year.
data_description.grid_fee_workday_entity: Optional sensor from the Workday integration to exclude holidays. Without it, the high period applies Monday–Friday during the season.

energy_flows.title: Production and export
energy_flows.description: Optional independent production, export and household-demand sources. Leave the switch off for ordinary import monitoring. Enabling it displays the source fields before saving. Turning it off clears these bindings and disables the optional diagnostic, while keeping remembered installation-presence answers. It does not mean that solar or battery equipment is absent. Sources are not detected or inferred automatically.

data.configure_energy_flows: Use optional production, export or household sources
data.household_power_entity: Measured household demand power (excluding battery charging)
data.confirm_flow_semantics: I confirm the selected sources have these meanings

data_description.configure_energy_flows: Select only separate, non-negative whole-site AC sources. Confirm their meanings before saving. Empty channels stay unconfigured; they are not assumed zero.
data_description.production_power_entity: AC generation excluding battery discharge. Do not use hybrid inverter output that mixes generation and storage.
data_description.production_energy_entity: Lifetime AC generation register excluding battery discharge, in Wh/kWh. Daily-reset and DC registers are unsupported.
data_description.grid_export_power_entity: Separate, non-negative directional grid export in W/kW. Signed net-grid power is not an export source.
data_description.grid_export_energy_entity: Lifetime energy delivered to the grid, in Wh/kWh. Keep it separate from imported energy.
data_description.household_power_entity: Whole-site AC load, including ordinary EV charging and distribution losses, excluding battery charging. A grid-import sensor measures only power drawn from the grid. It excludes the share of household demand supplied by local generation or battery discharge and can also include battery charging. Select a separate household-load source.
data_description.household_energy_entity: Lifetime register for the same household load, excluding battery charging, in Wh/kWh. It must cover household consumption whether supplied by the grid, local generation or battery discharge. An import register measures only energy drawn from the grid and can also include battery charging.
data_description.confirm_flow_semantics: The selected sources have these whole-site AC meanings and lifetime energy periods. No site balance, battery attribution or export revenue is calculated.

flow_compatibility.title: Installation and compatibility
flow_compatibility.description: Review installation facts whenever optional sources are configured. Choose Unknown / not confirmed when unsure; missing sensors do not mean equipment is absent. Phase conventions apply separately to the selected power sources; leave unverified conventions unknown. Whole-site AC boundaries are declared in the source step. You can save these facts without enabling the optional diagnostic. The diagnostic checks configured power observations only: it does not calculate household demand, energy ratios or balance readiness. Battery charge/discharge and explicit grid-import power inputs are not yet supported.

error.electricity_pro_source: Choose a source from another integration, not an Electricity Pro output. Leave optional sources empty if none is available.
error.invalid_grid_tariff: Enter both low and high fees and use valid HH:MM times and MM-DD season dates.
error.invalid_good_price_settings: Select Fixed or Adaptive, use a percentile from 1 to 100, and enter a valid optional ceiling.
error.pricing_metadata_required: Complete the price source type, included components, and VAT fields. Market energy must be selected.
error.tibber_sources_not_found: No enabled Tibber home with a current-power entity was found. Choose Custom or mixed sources, or enable the Tibber power entity.
error.markup_estimate_unavailable: No reliable estimate is available. Check the VAT rate, matching area, source availability, unique Tibber home names and currency. Prices must have at least four exact completed intervals covering one hour, with a nonnegative addition varying by no more than 0.01 per kWh. Multiple Tibber accounts are unsupported. Retry later, or uncheck confirmation to use manual pricing.
error.invalid_vat_suggestion: Enter a finite VAT percentage between 0 and 100 before confirming, or leave confirmation off to keep the previous setting.
error.invalid_supplier_amount: Enter a finite amount of zero or more; VAT must be between 0 and 100 percent.
error.invalid_measurement_source: Choose a sensor with a compatible measurement and unit.
error.invalid_market_source: Choose a native Nord Pool entry with valid areas and currency, or leave the source empty.
error.invalid_market_area: Choose an area configured in the selected Nord Pool integration.
error.invalid_grid_amount: Enter a finite amount of zero or more.
error.grid_amount_required: Enter at least one amount or choose Unconfigured.
error.grid_rate_required: Enter both the low-period and high-period rates. Zero is allowed.
error.invalid_flow_source: Choose distinct external power (W/kW) or lifetime energy (Wh/kWh) sources. Do not reuse an import source.
error.confirm_flow_semantics: Confirm the selected whole-site AC source meanings, including household load excluding battery charging, and lifetime energy registers.
error.contradictory_topology: Production sources are selected. Declare generation present or unknown, or return and remove those sources before declaring it absent.

data_description.pricing_strategy: Required when a price sensor is selected. Saving an older configuration confirms and activates the normalized pricing model.
data_description.price_included_components: Select every variable component already contained in the sensor value; Market energy must be included.
data_description.price_vat_treatment: State whether the selected price sensor includes VAT. VAT-excluded prices require a rate below; unknown VAT makes Effective Price unavailable.
data_description.price_vat_rate: Rate added only to VAT-exclusive live prices and Nord Pool forecasts. Already VAT-inclusive prices and configured VAT-inclusive fees are not taxed again. An unset rate is prefilled from a known Swedish, Danish or Finnish area. Check or edit before saving. Norway requires household-location confirmation and Iceland depends on supply type; use the suggestion helper if unsure. 0 means actual zero VAT, not that the source excludes VAT.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional sensor providing either today's consumption or a total accumulated energy reading.
data_description.energy_source_type: Choose whether the selected energy sensor resets each day or reports total accumulated imported energy. Total accumulated readings start with partial-day coverage until Electricity Pro observes the next local midnight.
data_description.accumulated_cost_today_entity: Optional external supplier-cost sensor reporting cost accumulated since midnight. Leave empty to estimate costs from the configured energy and price sources. Estimates have partial coverage. Do not select a fixed monthly fee.
data_description.current_l1_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L1.
data_description.current_l2_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L2.
data_description.current_l3_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous current for phase L3.
data_description.voltage_l1_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L1.
data_description.voltage_l2_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L2.
data_description.voltage_l3_entity: Optional sensor providing instantaneous voltage for phase L3.
data_description.monthly_peak_hour_consumption_entity: Optional sensor providing monthly peak hour consumption.
data_description.monthly_peak_hour_time_entity: Optional timestamp sensor providing when the monthly peak hour occurred.
data_description.grid_fee_per_kwh: Optional: Grid fee in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor, including VAT. In Sweden, this is typically 0.10–0.35 SEK/kWh, depending on the grid provider.
data_description.supplier_markup_per_kwh: Optional: Supplier markup in the same currency per kWh as the selected price sensor, including VAT. It is ignored for the live price when supplier markup is declared as already included, but is still used for market-only forecast scheduling prices.
data_description.energy_tax_per_kwh: Optional: Energy tax per kWh in the local currency, including VAT. For example, 0.45 SEK/kWh in Sweden. Check your grid agreement or bill because rates can change and reduced regional rates may apply.
data_description.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: Optional: Add a high-period fee to enable a weekday high/low tariff. The ordinary grid fee above is then used as the low-period fee.
data_description.grid_fee_high_start: Local start time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 06:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_end: Local end time for the high fee on Monday–Friday, for example 22:00.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_start: First date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 11-01.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_end: Last date of the recurring high season, written MM-DD; for example 03-31.
data_description.grid_fee_workday_entity: Optional: First add Home Assistant's Workday integration and configure your country (for example Sweden) with Holidays excluded. Then select its Workday sensor here. Dates reported as non-working use the low grid fee.
data_description.fixed_supplier_fee_monthly: Optional: Monthly fixed cost from the electricity supplier, if any.
data_description.fixed_grid_fee_monthly: Optional: Monthly fixed cost from the grid provider.
data_description.good_price_threshold: In Fixed mode, this is the maximum Effective Price considered good. In Adaptive mode, it is the optional fallback while history is warming up.
data_description.good_price_mode: Fixed preserves the existing threshold rule. Adaptive compares the current complete Effective Price with comparable historical local hours.
data_description.adaptive_target_percentile: Adaptive mode considers prices within this cheapest share of comparable historical observations favourable. The default is 25%.
data_description.adaptive_price_ceiling: Optional: Even when relatively favourable, a price above this absolute Effective Price is never classified as good.
data_description.forecast_nordpool_config_entry: Optional native Nord Pool integration used for forecast retrieval. Its configured area and currency are inherited automatically.
data_description.suggest_vat_rate: Optional: review a VAT suggestion or choose a country if no Nord Pool area is known. A known country is used directly. Existing rates, including 0%, stay unchanged unless you replace them.

forecast_area.title: Select forecast price area
forecast_area.description: The selected Nord Pool integration contains several price areas. Select the one Electricity Pro should use.

tibber_markup_estimate.title: Compare Tibber and Nord Pool
tibber_markup_estimate.description: Select the Nord Pool area for your Tibber home and confirm that they match. We cannot verify the home's price area automatically. Requires an explicit VAT rate and at least four matching completed intervals covering one hour. Leave confirmation unchecked to return to manual pricing.

data.forecast_price_area: Nord Pool area for this Tibber home
data.confirm_matching_area: I confirm this area matches my Tibber home; calculate an estimate

tibber_markup_review.title: Review estimated forecast addition
tibber_markup_review.description: Compared {count} completed intervals for {area}. Observed spread: {spread} {currency}/kWh. This VAT-inclusive addition can include variable costs beyond contractual markup and may change. Edit the suggestion if needed. It applies only to Nord Pool forecasts, not Tibber live prices or fixed fees. Leave confirmation unchecked to keep your manual value.

data.use_estimate: Use this value for Nord Pool forecasts

vat_country.title: Household VAT country
vat_country.description: Nord Pool country hint: {hint}. Confirm the country of this household's electricity supply, not just the forecast market. A price area is not a tax jurisdiction. No rate is saved until you confirm it. Other countries, special territories, businesses and uncertain cases should keep manual settings.

data.vat_country: Country of the household electricity supply

vat_context.title: Household VAT eligibility
vat_context.description: Norwegian VAT exemptions follow household location, not the NO4 price-area boundary. Icelandic reduced VAT applies only to qualifying heating electricity, not automatically to all household consumption. Choose the context for the selected supply; mixed or uncertain cases need manual configuration.

data.vat_context: Household location or electricity supply type

vat_review.title: Review household VAT suggestion
vat_review.description: Context: {context}. Previously entered rate: {previous}. Sources last checked: {verified}. [Tax authority guidance]({source}). Check the rate against your bill and edit it if necessary. Confirm only if this context applies to the household supply. It applies to VAT-exclusive live prices and Nord Pool forecasts; Tibber's VAT-inclusive live price and gross fees remain unchanged. This is a one-time saved rate, not automatic future tax updates. Leave confirmation off to keep the previous setting.

data.price_vat_rate: VAT to add to VAT-exclusive prices (%)
data.use_vat_suggestion: Confirm this rate for my household

grid.title: Grid charges
grid.description: Choose which grid charges you want to configure. Changing the tariff type displays its fields before saving. Use amounts from your grid agreement or bill, including VAT, in the same currency as your prices. Blank means unknown; enter 0 only for an actual zero charge. Components declared as already included under Electricity supplier are not added twice to live prices. These amounts can still apply to Nord Pool forecasts.

data.grid_fee_per_kwh: Variable grid fee per kWh (including VAT)
data.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: High-period grid fee per kWh (including VAT)

data_description.grid_mode: Unconfigured clears the grid amounts and schedule; it does not assume grid charges are zero. Single rate allows a variable fee, energy tax and/or monthly fixed fee. High/low requires both rates and a schedule.
data_description.grid_fee_per_kwh: Optional for a single rate; required as the low-period fee for a high/low tariff.
data_description.energy_tax_per_kwh: Optional. Use the applicable rate from your bill, including regional reductions. No national rate is assumed.
data_description.fixed_grid_fee_monthly: Optional fixed fee from the grid provider. Keep capacity charges and electricity-supplier fees separate.
data_description.grid_fee_high_per_kwh: The full high-period rate, not an addition to the low rate. Zero is a valid rate.
data_description.grid_fee_high_start: Local start time on Monday–Friday, for example 06:00. Overnight periods are supported.
data_description.grid_fee_high_end: Local end time on Monday–Friday, for example 22:00. Must differ from the start.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_start: First date of the recurring season, for example 11-01.
data_description.grid_fee_high_season_end: Last date of the recurring season, for example 03-31. A season can span New Year.
data_description.grid_fee_workday_entity: Optional sensor from the Workday integration to exclude holidays. Without it, the high period applies Monday–Friday during the season.

error.electricity_pro_source: Choose a source from another integration, not an Electricity Pro output. Leave optional sources empty if none is available.
error.invalid_grid_tariff: Enter both low and high fees and use valid HH:MM times and MM-DD season dates.
error.invalid_good_price_settings: Select Fixed or Adaptive, use a percentile from 1 to 100, and enter a valid optional ceiling.
error.pricing_metadata_required: Complete the price source type, included components, and VAT fields. Market energy must be selected.
error.invalid_flow_source: Choose distinct external power (W/kW) or lifetime energy (Wh/kWh) sources. Do not reuse an import source.
error.contradictory_topology: Production sources are selected. Declare generation present or unknown, or return and remove those sources before declaring it absent.
error.confirm_flow_semantics: Confirm the selected whole-site AC source meanings, including household load excluding battery charging, and lifetime energy registers.
error.markup_estimate_unavailable: No reliable estimate is available. Check the VAT rate, matching area, source availability, unique Tibber home names and currency. Prices must have at least four exact completed intervals covering one hour, with a nonnegative addition varying by no more than 0.01 per kWh. Multiple Tibber accounts are unsupported. Retry later, or uncheck confirmation to use manual pricing.
error.invalid_vat_suggestion: Enter a finite VAT percentage between 0 and 100 before confirming, or leave confirmation off to keep the previous setting.
error.invalid_supplier_amount: Enter a finite amount of zero or more; VAT must be between 0 and 100 percent.
error.invalid_measurement_source: Choose a sensor with a compatible measurement and unit.
error.invalid_market_source: Choose a native Nord Pool entry with valid areas and currency, or leave the source empty.
error.invalid_market_area: Choose an area configured in the selected Nord Pool integration.
error.invalid_grid_amount: Enter a finite amount of zero or more.
error.grid_amount_required: Enter at least one amount or choose Unconfigured.
error.grid_rate_required: Enter both the low-period and high-period rates. Zero is allowed.
